_comment: Initial google-cloud-mock state for ab-testing. Stands in for the
account state a human set up once in the real GCP project: the
abtesting_logging-* log bucket the task's log entry must go to.
Everything else (the ab_testing dataset and its 20 tables) is created
at container start by upstream preprocess/main.py running VERBATIM
against this mock, exactly as it runs against real BigQuery upstream.
The bucket id matches groundtruth_workspace/log_bucket_name.txt so
preprocess and grader agree on the name, as they do upstream where
both read the same repo file.
